algorithm: PPO, SAC, TRPO, DDPG, TD3, HAPPO, HATRPO, MAPPO, IPPO, MADDPG, BCQ, TD3+BC, IQL, MAML, ProMP
headline_metric: episode reward and normalized offline-RL / multi-task score (no success rate reported in the paper)
paper_code_mismatch: Paper states the policy controls joints via relative position at 30 Hz; shipped yaml configs use controlFrequencyInv=1 (60 Hz comment) with useRelativeControl=False. Lift Underarm reward in the paper is an ungated 0.985 constant, but code gates it on both hands within 8 cm of the handles and uses 0.385. HAPPO hyperparameters (lr, max grad norm, env steps) differ between paper Table 44 and shipped cfg/happo/config.yaml. Paper claims 30,000+ FPS; README claims 40,000+ mean FPS.
